rows.label: qst500104_msg0001
rows.name:
Mo-mo-mo?! Someone kind came along,
mo!

rows.label: qst500104_msg0002
rows.name:
Yamayama came to Superbia to look for
ingredients for delicious juice, mo.

rows.label: qst500104_msg0003
rows.name:
I tried climbing to Superbia's head
to look for ingredients, but somehow
I got lost, mo...

rows.label: qst500104_msg0004
rows.name:
I ran out of food and ate a Sappanwood
Beetle, but it actually tastes pretty
good, mo.

rows.label: qst500104_msg0006
rows.name:
Please tell me how to get out of
here, mo!

rows.label: qst500104_msg0007
rows.name:
I see, I understand, mo!
Thank you, mo!

rows.label: qst500104_msg0008
rows.name:
I don't want to get lost again, so
I'll head straight back to Avaritia,
mo.

rows.label: qst500104_msg0009
rows.name:
Bringing back Sappanwood Beetles
should be enough to show for the trip,
mo.

rows.label: qst500104_msg0010
rows.name:
Some of my other siblings are also
looking for juice ingredients, mo.

rows.label: qst500104_msg0011
rows.name:
If you meet them, please be as kind
to them as you were to me, mo!
